We'll reach the vital point of the weredragons if\nwe go this way...
Well, let's get going then!
But first we need to let those in the village this\nway know that we're going there. That's the rule.
What? But that's the opposite way tho?\nWhy do we have to do something troublesome like\nthat?
Because the vital point is an important place to\nthe weredragons. They're monitoring it from that\nvillage to make sure there are no intruders.
If someone tries to go near it, a team will\nimmediately be dispatched to go after them.
Wow, that's no joke!
The same goes for me too. If I go there without\npermission, a team will be dispatched to get me\nand I'll be scolded severely...
So we need to notify them.\nWell, the village representative knows me.\nHe won't give us trouble.
The weredragons village is just up ahead, but\nplease be careful of traps...

This is the trap I mean. There are holes\neverywhere just like the one you just fell into.\nBut it'll just send you back here, you won't die.
T-that's enough to make me think that I was gonna\ndie...
Hey, who set up these traps?
It must be the tigers from the other day...
Those dragons wanted to destroy the weredragons\ncompletely so bad, remember? I don't think they'd\nset up these kind of cheap traps though...
Whatever, shouldn't we prioritize going to the\nvital point of the weredragons now?\nLet's hurry guys!
